statistical_unit: one c100 round; five round means/P95s remain separate
summary_method: median and min/max of observed round means, separate median and min/max of round nearest-rank P95s
limitations: 500 request pool is descriptive only; requests within a burst share resources and are not 500 independent rounds.
Sparse stages summarize only measured requests; missing values are never zero and marker records are not duration samples.
Outer, inner, parallel and residual stages overlap. Do not add aggregate columns or subtract different percentile values.
Frontdoor monotonic, Master component durations and Host wall-log chains retain separate semantics; no absolute axis splicing.
This file summarizes measured stages, not a CPU/wait/SQL causal attribution. Separate diagnostic runs must stay outside these five rounds.
